meta.caseName: DCS ODS Spot Beam Simulator - Wallops, VA | GOES West | 16.4 m
meta.disclaimer: Public engineering sensitivity simulation, not a coordination determination or operator commitment. The -27 dBi far-angle receive level, traffic scheduler, NRAO transfer calibration, and ODS actions require site/operator validation.

site.name: Wallops, VA
site.heightSourceStatus: Catalog feed height above local ground used as a geodetic-height proxy; replace with surveyed antenna-reference height when available.
site.visibilityConvention: local geometric horizon (0-degree minimum LEO elevation)

boresight.longitudeSource: NOAA GOES-R fleet: GOES-East 75.2 W; GOES-West 137.0 W

antenna.sidelobeFloorUsage: unused by the selected S.580/APEREC015 model
antenna.farAngleOverrideStatus: Unverified public sensitivity assumption applied to every catalog receiver beyond the S.580 far-angle breakpoint; replace with measured site data.
antenna.reference: ITU-R S.580-6 with attached APEREC015 Appendix 8 extension where applicable
antenna.applicabilityNote: D/lambda = 91.898109; using ITU-R S.580-6 D/lambda >= 50 form.

constellation.sourceNote: Engineering two-shell D2C baseline: 325 satellites at 340 km/53 degrees and 325 at 355 km/43 degrees.

beams.boresightDirection: 10 snapshot steering positions inside the field of regard
beams.layoutOrientation: Earth-fixed local east/north snapshot steering lattice
beams.spotWidthInterpretation: The 60-degree value is steering field of regard, not beamwidth. Each spot has a separately configurable -3 dB angular radius.
beams.halfPowerBoundaryDefinition: Configured satellite-view -3 dB angular radius for each independently steered spot.
beams.offAxisMaskMarginStatus: Optional calibration assumption; zero in the default case so the S.1528 reference envelope is retained without extra satellite-pattern credit.
beams.scanLossCompensationNote: Modeled power control compensates projected-aperture scan loss so every spot retains the same peak EIRP-density ceiling.
beams.patternReference: ITU-R S.1528-0 LEO reference pattern plus explicit configurable off-axis mask margin.
beams.footprintModel: 10 narrow spots at snapshot steering positions; every visible satellite can couple through spot sidelobes
beams.frequencyReuseAssumption: Four 5-MHz carriers with cyclic assignment; 3 of 10 positions use the carrier containing 1679.9 MHz, with at most one such beam scheduled per satellite.
beams.loadingInterpretation: Two-state per-satellite scheduler with one protected-carrier spot at most.
beams.cellEdgeInterpretation: The configured spot half-power radius is independent of the 60-degree field of regard.
beams.sourceNote: The 10-point lattice defines snapshot steering locations only; it does not assert continuous tiling of the field of regard.

za.definition: No D2D served user/active beam center inside 30 km of the protected receiver
za.sourceStatus: User-defined 30-km geographic avoidance radius; not a coordination result.

resources.frequencyPlan: Four contiguous 5-MHz carriers with static four-color assignment
resources.frequencyPlanStatus: Configurable constellation assumption, not a disclosed operator scheduler.
resources.trafficModel: Two-state burst scheduler; one protected-carrier spot per satellite; ZA-aware reassignment
resources.trafficSourceStatus: Engineering traffic assumption requiring operator validation.

rf.eirpBasis: User-selected 30 dBW/MHz maximum EIRP density for every spot beam.
rf.perCellEirpConvention: Every active spot has the same 30 dBW/MHz maximum boresight EIRP density; pattern and load reduce off-axis/instantaneous EIRP only.
rf.maximumPfdSource: Prior FCC engineering-table assumption; applied per beam after range loss.
rf.activitySourceStatus: Compatibility alias for the burst scheduler.
rf.atmosphericLossUsage: zero when the propagation model is enabled

propagation.belowLookupTreatment: Use the 5-degree P.618 value for visible 0-to-5-degree links.
propagation.atmosphericReference: ITU-R P.618 lookup generated with MATLAB Satellite Communications Toolbox
propagation.clutterReference: ITU-R P.2108-1 open/rural height-gain model; provisional heights

aggregation.selectionMetric: all visible satellites with a scheduled ZA-permitted protected-carrier spot
aggregation.selectionOrder: calculate every link, apply ODS action, then sum powers linearly

ods.minimumOperationalOuterAngleStatus: No operating floor; the search selects the unconstrained minimum modeled angle pair.
ods.outerRetaskMode: retask protected-carrier spots to a feasible center at least 180 km from the protected receiver and recompute gain
ods.actionMode: physical outer beam retasking and inner protected-carrier shutdown
ods.unaffectedBeamOperation: Outside the outer cone operation is unchanged; in the annulus the protected-carrier spot is retasked; in the inner cone it is shut down.
ods.mitigationSourceStatus: 180-km retasking is an NRAO-informed engineering assumption; inner action is exact protected-carrier shutdown; no outer-angle operating floor is applied.

calibration.transferMode: Relative NRAO sidelobe correction transferred from 1990-1995 MHz to 1675-1695 MHz
calibration.sourceStatus: Provisional cross-service engineering calibration; receiver- and band-specific measurements supersede it.

uncertainty.powerTreatment: Independent beam uncertainty below the 30 dBW/MHz ceiling; positive excursions clipped at the ceiling.
uncertainty.angularGeometryTreatment: Angular errors are clamped to visible sky.

reporting.note: Strict result permits no modeled sample above -6 dB I/N in any Monte Carlo run.

search.serviceImpactNote: Select the smallest outer-plus-inner angle pair meeting strict protection.
